delete_rows.description: Remove the rows that match a filter. Provide the column/value conditions that pick which rows to delete. A non-empty filter is required so you never delete every row by accident.
delete_rows.name: delete_rows

parameters.description: The database that contains the table. Pick one, or leave blank to use the connection's default database.
parameters.name: database

parameters.description: The table to act on. Pick a table, or type its name (for example 'events'). Choose a database first to load its tables.
parameters.name: table

parameters.description: Which rows to delete, as column/value pairs (for example, id: 42). A row is deleted only when it equals every value given (combined with AND). Must be non-empty; deleting every row is not allowed.
parameters.name: filter

database.description: Database of the table (null when the default was used)

matched_by.description: Filter columns used to select rows

status.description: 'applied' once ClickHouse has run the delete

find_rows.description: Read rows from a table, optionally only those matching column/value conditions, sorted by a column. Returns up to 1,000 rows.
find_rows.name: find_rows

parameters.description: The database that contains the table. Pick one, or leave blank to use the connection's default database.
parameters.name: database

parameters.description: The table to act on. Pick a table, or type its name (for example 'events'). Choose a database first to load its tables.
parameters.name: table

parameters.description: Only rows equal to every value given, as column/value pairs (for example, status: "paid"). Leave blank for any row.
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: The column to sort by, such as created_at. Leave blank for ClickHouse's own order.
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.description: The most rows to return, up to 1,000. Defaults to 100.
parameters.name: limit

database.description: Database read from (null when the default was used)

rows.description: The rows found, each as column/value pairs

insert_rows.description: Add one or more rows to a table. Each row is given as column/value pairs; columns you omit fall back to their defaults, so you only provide the columns you have values for.
insert_rows.name: insert_rows

parameters.description: The database that contains the table. Pick one, or leave blank to use the connection's default database.
parameters.name: database

parameters.description: The table to act on. Pick a table, or type its name (for example 'events'). Choose a database first to load its tables.
parameters.name: table

parameters.description: The rows to insert, as a list of objects. Each object maps column names to values, for example [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada"}, {"id": 2, "name": "Grace"}].
parameters.name: rows

database.description: Database written to (null when the default was used)

inserted_rows.description: Number of rows sent to ClickHouse

update_rows.description: Change column values on the rows that match a filter. Provide the new values to set and the column/value conditions that pick which rows to update. A non-empty filter is required so you never update every row by accident.
update_rows.name: update_rows

parameters.description: The database that contains the table. Pick one, or leave blank to use the connection's default database.
parameters.name: database

parameters.description: The table to act on. Pick a table, or type its name (for example 'events'). Choose a database first to load its tables.
parameters.name: table

parameters.description: The columns to change and their new values, as column/value pairs (for example, status: "archived", score: 10).
parameters.name: assignments

parameters.description: Which rows to update, as column/value pairs (for example, id: 42). A row is updated only when it equals every value given (combined with AND). Must be non-empty; updating every row is not allowed.
parameters.name: filter

database.description: Database of the updated table (null when the default was used)

matched_by.description: Filter columns used to select rows

status.description: 'applied' once ClickHouse has run the update

description: Find, insert, update, and delete rows in your ClickHouse database tables.

clickhouse_new_row_trigger.description: Runs when a row is added to a ClickHouse table, found by checking for rows past the highest value seen so far of a column that grows with every new row, such as created_at. Rows already in the table don't trigger it. Each check is a query, so a ClickHouse Cloud service doesn't go idle while the workflow is on.

parameters.description: The database the table is in.
parameters.name: database

parameters.description: A column whose value grows with every new row, such as a created-at time or an increasing number. It must be in the table's ORDER BY or PARTITION BY.
parameters.name: column
